quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #10
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: A broken yellow line down the center of a road means:

options.text: You cannot pass from either direction.
You can pass from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can pass from either direction.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line means any driver can pass when no traffic is coming toward them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must stop completely.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and check that the way is clear before you go.

questions.question: What does a double solid yellow line mean?

options.text: You can pass from the left.
You can pass from the right.
You cannot pass from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot pass from either direction.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean traffic is moving in opposite directions. You cannot pass other vehicles from either side.

questions.question: When driving behind another car at night, you should:

options.text: Use high beam headlights until you are within 10 feet of the car ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when following another car at night. Use high beams only in rural areas when no other cars are nearby.

questions.question: When driving near a motorcycle, you must:

options.text: Give the motorcycle a full lane.
Drive on the shoulder beside the motorcycle.
Allow the motorcycle to share half a lane.
Pass using the same lane as the motorcycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the motorcycle a full lane.
questions.explanation: A motorcycle is a full-size vehicle. It needs a complete lane to move safely, even if it looks like there is room to share.

questions.question: When you see a flashing red traffic light, you must:
questions.correctAnswerText: Stop before entering the intersection.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. Check that it is safe, then go. At railroad crossings, a flashing red light means a train is coming. Wait until the lights stop flashing and all warning signals are off.

questions.question: Before changing lanes, you should:

options.text: Check your side mirror and look over your shoulder to make sure the lane is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your side mirror and look over your shoulder to make sure the lane is clear.
questions.explanation: Always check your side mirrors and look over your shoulder before changing lanes.

questions.question: A downward-facing triangular sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A downward-facing triangular sign tells drivers to yield. Let other traffic or pedestrians pass first, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: When passing on a multilane highway, you should:

options.text: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
You do not need to signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
questions.explanation: Before passing, check that the passing lane is clear and use your turn signal.

questions.question: If there is a deep puddle on the road, you should:

options.text: Keep your speed to get through the water.
Shift into neutral as you drive through.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid the puddle if possible.
questions.explanation: Avoid wet areas like puddles to prevent skidding. Dry, solid surfaces are safest for driving.

questions.question: When driving on snow or ice:

options.text: It is safe to use cruise control.
Change your speed and direction slowly and carefully.
Drive the same way you would on normal roads.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change your speed and direction slowly and carefully.
questions.explanation: When driving on snow or ice, change your speed and direction slowly. Do not use cruise control on snow or ice. Your tires may slip and you could lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: To stay out of a truck or bus driver's blind spot, you should:

options.text: Do not drive beside them and do not drive too close behind them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not drive beside them and do not drive too close behind them.
questions.explanation: Large trucks and buses have large blind spots on the sides and back. Do not drive beside them and do not tailgate them.

questions.question: You are in an accident and someone is injured. You should:

options.text: Move the injured person away from the scene right away.
Always leave the injured person where they are.
Do not move the injured person unless necessary. Keep them warm and give first aid.
Stay away from the injured person.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not move the injured person unless necessary. Keep them warm and give first aid.
questions.explanation: Do not move an injured person unless you must. Moving them the wrong way can make injuries worse. Keep them warm until help arrives. If there is heavy bleeding, press down on the wound to stop the blood.

questions.question: When you come to a flashing red light, you should:

options.text: Slow down and let others go first.
Slow down and drive carefully through the intersection.
Stop completely, look both ways, and go when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, look both ways, and go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same thing as a stop sign. You must stop completely, let other traffic and pedestrians go first, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: A solid yellow line on your side of the road means:
questions.correctAnswerText: Do not pass.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow line on your side means you cannot pass. Solid yellow lines mark areas where passing is not safe. If both lines are solid, no one can pass in either direction.

questions.question: When you see a flashing yellow light at an intersection, you must:

options.text: Wait for a green light before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and cross carefully.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and be careful. Watch for other cars and pedestrians before crossing.

questions.question: Speed does not affect how far your vehicle travels after you brake.
questions.correctAnswerText: FALSE
questions.explanation: As you drive faster, your vehicle needs more distance to stop. Stay far behind the car in front of you, especially at high speeds.

questions.question: When passing another vehicle, it is safe to move back to your lane if you:

options.text: Cannot see the vehicle to your right.
See the vehicle's headlights in your rearview mirror.
Have passed the vehicle's front bumper.

questions.correctAnswerText: See the vehicle's headlights in your rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: Before moving back to your lane after passing, make sure you are not too close to the other vehicle. When you can see both headlights in your rearview mirror, you have enough room to move back.

questions.question: You are approaching an intersection at the speed limit when the light turns yellow. You should:

options.text: Slow down and go through without being careful.
Speed up to cross before the light turns red.
Stop before entering the intersection if you can do so safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop before entering the intersection if you can do so safely.
questions.explanation: A yellow light means caution and the light will turn red soon. Stop if you can do so safely. If you cannot stop safely, cross the intersection with care.

questions.question: What colors are signs that show the distance to the next highway exit?
questions.correctAnswerText: Green with white letters
questions.explanation: Signs that give you information about destinations are green with white letters.

questions.question: When merging onto an interstate highway, what should you do?

options.text: Find a safe gap and merge into traffic.
Merge across two lanes at the same time.
Always stop before entering the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Find a safe gap and merge into traffic.
questions.explanation: When merging, find a gap large enough to safely enter the traffic flow. Do not stop on the entrance ramp unless there is no safe gap to merge into.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Divided highway ends.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the divided highway is ending. Get ready to change lanes or shift your position.

questions.question: When backing up, what should you do?

options.text: Open your door to check if it is safe.
Turn your head and look through the rear window.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look through the rear window.
questions.explanation: Before backing up, always check behind your vehicle. Children and small objects are hard to see from the driver's seat. Turn your head to look through the rear window. Do not rely only on mirrors or sensors.

questions.question: If a bus is signaling to return to the main road after stopping, you must:

options.text: Honk to let the driver know you are there.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield.
questions.explanation: You must yield to any bus that is signaling to re-enter traffic after loading or unloading passengers. Change lanes, slow down, or stop to let the bus safely return to traffic.

questions.question: Before passing another vehicle, when should you signal?

options.text: Early enough so others know your plans.

questions.correctAnswerText: Early enough so others know your plans.
questions.explanation: Signal early before passing so other drivers know what you plan to do.
